# Coherent complete-core observation within the engine turn

Exact base:19ab17362c7bb8f022eb6b25183c337cd96bb68f. Base bot:local_economic_core_01. This is a repair of the completed economic strategy, not a new strategy or threshold tune.

Only modify candidate src/live_turn.h and src/economic_scene_sdk.cpp; add focused tests/economic_capture_batches.cpp and required IMPLEMENTATION.md. Existing tests may only receive minimal host injection hooks needed for new scenarios; preserve all existing assertions and document exact edits. No other production module, SDK, policy, constants, item choices, route capacities or dispatch changes. No game/build/upload/ranked changes on Pi. Return promptly; PC owns real SDK review and engine measurements.

Diagnosis from exact complete-core release: Swirl and Vault four allies never move through round40. Buffered engine probes (no printing until after round20) show Swirl warm capture crosses rounds before returning; Vault warm capture returns about21000 of100000 fuel, then EconomicFields::eligible requires30000, so prepare_delivery permanently returns deferred. Complete trace details remain PC-local. Per-getter LiveTurn::read checks epoch and fuel before/after every read; guard overhead repeats for many scalar getters. Do not solve by lowering field_admission30000/reserve5000 or discarding facts.

Implement bounded public read-only getter batches inside EconomicCapture. Design a narrow explicitly used batch reader in LiveTurn, separate from ordinary read and perform/preflight. A structural maximum of8 public calls per batch is the initial engineering ceiling, not a measured optimum. Each batch checks the original full epoch(actor/life/round/revision) and reserve at entry/exit; every explicit public call still increments shared queries_issued before issuance and queries_completed on normal return, with overflow protection. Expected/exceptional exits must perform stale/epoch validation before their result can be interpreted as current. A failing batch never publishes any scene/cache/lifecycle changes; unexpected errors propagate and no remaining getter is issued after detection. Batches cannot adopt a newer epoch or reset any ledger quota. No destructor may query SDK, throw or mutate game state. No callback may perform actions, preflight, yields, purchases, priority, channels, shared-memory changes or arbitrary nested work. Keep ordinary LiveTurn::read and all mutation/preflight behavior unchanged.

Use explicit audited bounded capture blocks: scalar own state/permissions, ability scalar values, per-visible-member identity/HP/strength and per-champion scalar rows. Public camp_at is compound (identity/map_info/group), champion_at constructs ability metadata; keep these public SDK wrappers and count each explicit wrapper call honestly. Do not use private info/raw imports. Do not silently reuse handles/scalars whose freshness/visibility is unproved. No whole-capture giant lambda/batch. Keep bitboard/native operations and group.state (vision+native spawn tests+lifecycle) under their existing independent guards; they cannot hide in a cheap getter batch. All row/scene/capacity checks stay. Group capture_state can be independent or a specifically audited small batch, but no unbounded native work. Structural loop limits come from existing supported bounds; never truncate a required collection to fit.

Keep capture's immutable start epoch and final complete-scene check; scratch remains provisional. All existing unknown harmful sibling handling, patch proof, lifecycle publication and pending receipt behavior must remain. Late batch detection may execute a bounded read tail after suspension; record this limitation. An SDK error may allocate diagnostic text internally before being caught; no universal reserve/error-cost claim. An accepted complete scene must still come from one full epoch; service/bank/action validation is not batched.

Required focused tests with real pinned public wrappers where practical: same-round scalar result and ledger equality; guards reduced while every getter issuance/completion remains counted; rollover within first/middle/final call; actor/life/revision change; error after several successes; expected visibility error versus crossed epoch; overflow before issuance; no subsequent batch/action/cache publication after stale. Include at least camp_at/champion_at public compound paths and verify original assertions unchanged. If Pi cannot run actual SDK host fixtures, write the focused fixture and state what remains for PC. Avoid broad new harness work or attempting a tournament.

Report exact getter/batch limits, audited wrapper branches, code changes, checks actually run and remaining engine admission/memory questions. This is a hypothesis to test: no claim of equivalent suspension timing, resource qualification or a stronger bot from native tests alone.
